name: Sunken Insignias
description: Recover relics from the sentinels of the Drowned Ruins.

dialogue.offer: Four Sentinel Relics could identify the people who built these ruins. Will you recover them?
dialogue.in_progress: The drowned guardians still patrol the flooded halls.
dialogue.ready: These markings match the oldest records in my collection.
dialogue.completed: The nameless city has a history again.
